remarks: Welcome to 2191 Cedar Glen Cir in the desirable La Paloma community! This beautifully updated, two-story detached condominium offers 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and approximately 1,999 square feet of living space, with access to the community pool. The fully renovated kitchen features solid wood cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, while all bathrooms have been completely remodeled for a fresh, cohesive look. Freshly painted interior and exterior surfaces add to the home’s appeal. A versatile downstairs space is ideal for a home office, with all four bedrooms located upstairs.
